title: Finding Our Feelings Compass

warmUp.question: When was the last time you felt surprised at school?
warmUp.sampleAnswer: I felt surprised when my friend gave me a gift.

vocabulary.sentence: I felt worried before the big test.
She was scared of the dark hallway.
He looked confused by the new rules.
The new student felt shy on the first day.
We were surprised by the kind message.
They felt happy after helping a friend.
I felt sad when my friend moved away.
He felt angry, then took a deep breath.
She felt bored during the long wait.
We felt excited about the class trip.

sentenceFrames: If I felt worried, I would ____.
If my friend looked shy, I would ____.
When I feel confused, I usually ____.

story.title: Mia's Monday Compass

pages.heading: Morning Jitters
pages.text: Mia walked into class feeling worried. The new project looked hard, and she felt a little shy about asking for help.

pages.heading: A Confusing Task
pages.text: The instructions left her confused. For a moment she felt scared she would fail, but her partner smiled and explained the first step.

pages.heading: A Happy Finish
pages.text: When they finished, Mia felt surprised by how well it went. She left school happy and ready to try again tomorrow.

comprehensionQuestions.question: How did Mia feel at the start of the day?
comprehensionQuestions.sampleAnswer: She felt worried and a little shy.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What made Mia feel confused?
comprehensionQuestions.sampleAnswer: The project instructions were hard to understand.

comprehensionQuestions.question: How did Mia feel at the end?
Why do you think Mia felt surprised at the end?
comprehensionQuestions.sampleAnswer: Because the hard project went better than she expected.

creativeQuestions: If you felt worried like Mia, what would you do first?
Would you feel shy or happy asking a classmate for help? Why?

speaking.question: What makes you feel happy at school?
speaking.sampleAnswer: Talking with friends makes me feel happy.

speaking.question: What do you do if you feel confused in class?
speaking.sampleAnswer: I ask the teacher or a friend.

speaking.question: Have you ever felt surprised by kind words?
speaking.sampleAnswer: Yes, a note from my friend surprised me.

speaking.question: Is it okay to feel shy on the first day?
speaking.sampleAnswer: Yes, many people feel shy at first.

speaking.question: What helps when you feel scared?
speaking.sampleAnswer: Taking a breath and talking to someone helps.

activity.title: Feelings Face Lab
activity.prompt: Round 1: build a feeling face and say how it feels. Round 2: partner guesses, then answer with If I felt ____, I would ____.
templates: My partner guessed ____, but I meant ____.
My friend looks ____, so I would ____.

reviewSentences: It is normal to feel worried before something new.
If I felt confused, I would ask a clear question.
A small kindness can turn shy feelings into happy ones.
